Native-reviewed canonical source transcript and English translation identical to the single recorded turn
Rights/license and consent metadata; source-text SHA-256, recording SHA-256 and checked sample rate/codec
Two human approvals: native-text reviewer and independent acoustic listening reviewer
No provider requests, audio publishing, recording placeholders in generated lessons or Speak scoring before separate approved content PR
